poc_plan: Objective: validate throughput guarantees and latency SLOs for peak traffic and long-lived churn
Environment: Dedicated cluster (VPC) with customer-like network egress and KMS integration
Workloads: 70% short chat queries (avg 40 tokens), 20% reranking (top-k 10), 10% embeddings batch jobs
Traffic profile: base QPS 200 => burst to 2k QPS for 3-5 minute spikes; sustained 500 QPS soak for 48 hours
Metrics to collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, memory (KV cache) hit rates, OOM events, tail latencies for cold starts
Tests: progressive load ramp (10m steps), worst-case sequence length runs (2048 tokens), KV prefix caching enabled/disabled compare
Soak: 48h sustained workload at 70% of provisioned capacity to validate thermal throttling, memory leak, and degradation patterns
Failover: validate smart routing fallback to lower-accuracy quantized variant within 200ms without user impact
Acceptance criteria: p95 chat latency < 160ms under steady 500 QPS; no OOMs; sustained throughput within 10% of target; autoscaler triggers within policy bounds
Deliverables: runbook, observed metrics dashboard, cost projection per 1M tokens, recommended reserved GPU count + burst policy
